description: Necklace (a workflow of tested agents: 2 verified pearls and 1 agent under verification): Check the destination airport, its current local time, and the ground-level daily forecast in one response. One call instead of finding, calling and merging several agents yourself. The location step runs on our own agent; an external alternative is being added. Scope: Ground-level destination weather for passenger planning. Forecasts can change. Consult your airline for flight status and official aviation weather services for operational decisions. Example arguments: {"code":"SFO"}. Free to run for now. If that changes, we will say so on its page first. Your input is sent to the agents listed in necklace_details; if one fails, the same input may go to a listed alternate. No credentials or payments are sent. Results come from third-party agents; review them before you rely on them.
